articles.title: Apuestas y pronósticos Villarreal vs Betis
articles.standfirst: Betfair te ofrece el pronóstico del partido que enfrenta al Villarreal y al Real Betis en el Estadio de la Cerámica correspondiente a la quinta jornada de LaLiga
articles.summary: Betfair te ofrece el pronóstico del partido que enfrenta al Villarreal y al Real Betis en el Estadio de la Cerámica correspondiente a la quinta jornada de LaLiga
articles.body: El Villarreal recibe al Betis este lunes en el Estadio de la Cerámica, en el partido que cierra la quinta jornada de LaLiga 26/27. El conjunto de Íñigo Pérez afronta el encuentro sin conocer todavía la victoria. Suma solo dos puntos de doce posibles y encadena dos derrotas consecutivas, la última de ellas especialmente dolorosa ante el Deportivo, en un partido en el que llegó a adelantarse dos veces y terminó cayendo en el minuto 88. Los de Vila-real son, junto al Elche, el Valencia, el Málaga y el Celta, uno de los cinco equipos que aún no ha ganado esta temporada. Favorito para el partido entre Villarreal y Betis Por su parte, el Betis llega a la Cerámica lanzado tras dos victorias de gran mérito. El conjunto de Manuel Pellegrini se impuso 1-0 al Real Madrid en La Cartuja, asestando al conjunto blanco su primera derrota liguera de la temporada, y remontó después al Lille en su debut en la Champions League. Con nueve puntos de doce posibles, los verdiblancos son cuartos clasificados y podrían abrir una brecha de once puntos sobre su rival de esta noche si logran la victoria. Con todos estos datos, las casas de apuestas dan como favorito al Villarreal, aunque sin una diferencia demasiado amplia. Betfair paga la victoria visitante a cuota 3.5, por 3.75 del empate y 1.85 de la victoria del cuadro amarillo. Ambos equipos marcan El mercado de ambos equipos marcan aparece como una de las alternativas más interesantes del encuentro. El Villarreal ha encajado goles en la práctica totalidad de sus partidos disputados, con una defensa que sigue sin encontrar solidez, mientras que el Betis, pese a su buen momento, tampoco ha logrado mantener siempre su portería a cero. Con estos datos, según las apuestas deportivas, la probabilidad de que ambos equipos anoten es alta. Betfair paga a 1.45 el "sí" y a 2.5 el "no". Número total de goles (Over/Under) El mercado de goles apunta hacia un partido con cierto potencial ofensivo. El Villarreal cuenta con futbolistas de nivel arriba, como Gerard Moreno, Pépé o Mikautadze, y suele generar ocasiones incluso en sus derrotas, mientras que el Betis ha demostrado capacidad goleadora tanto en LaLiga como en Europa en las últimas semanas. Con estos datos, Betfair sitúa la cuota del +2.5 totales a 1.52, por 2.4 del caso contrario. Número total de córners (Over/Under) El mercado de córners se presenta como una alternativa interesante para los apostantes. El Villarreal, con un juego de posesión y ataque por bandas, suele generar un volumen alto de saques de esquina jugando como local en la Cerámica, especialmente cuando necesita remontar un resultado adverso. El Betis, por su parte, ha mostrado en sus últimas salidas un estilo también asociativo, lo que invita a pensar en un partido con un reparto ajustado de córners entre ambos conjuntos.

articles.title: College Fantasy Football Week 3 Waiver Wire Pickups: Michael Hawkins Jr., Jaleel Skinner among top players to add under 10% rostered
articles.summary: College fantasy football analyst Eric Froton recommends some players to add off the waiver wire going into Week 3.
articles.body:
It was an eventful Week 2 of the college fantasy football season, with plenty of surprises from a CFF standpoint that we need to account for. I focused on players who were rostered in 10% of leagues or less in order to spotlight players who can help your college fantasy teams immediately.

The athletic specimen continued his torrid start by accounting for four touchdowns in West Virginia 's 52-7 demolition of UT Martin, producing 35.8 fantasy points. Hawkins completed 5-of-7 passes for 155 yards and two touchdowns while adding 96 rushing yards and two scores, including an explosive 71-yard touchdown run that showcased his game-breaking athleticism. The Oklahoma transfer has now exceeded 23 fantasy points in consecutive outings after scoring 23.6 points in Week 1, giving him 59.4 points through his first two appearances. While Saturday's abbreviated seven-attempt passing workload limits the predictive value of his aerial production, the designed rushing involvement and open-field explosiveness are sustainable CFF assets in HC Rich Rodriguez's run-heavy scheme.

West Virginia's upcoming schedule features Virginia at a neutral site, Oklahoma State at home and Iowa State on the road. Virginia represents Hawkins' first meaningful Power Four test, but Oklahoma State just surrendered 31 points in a shootout win vs. Oregon and projects as the most attractive matchup of the three. His passing efficiency will inevitably regress against stronger defenses, but a quarterback averaging 29.7 fantasy points per game with a featured rushing role deserves immediate attention.

Lopez authored one of Week 2's most impressive dual-threat performances while leading Wake Forest past Purdue in double overtime. Lopez completed 16-of-27 passes for 225 yards and one touchdown while adding 59 rushing yards and two scores on 13 carries, producing 32.9 fantasy points. The 13 rushing attempts are the most important number for CFF purposes, as they reveal a designed component of the offense rather than production derived solely from broken-play scrambles. Lopez protected the football, consistently extended drives and accounted for three of Wake's touchdowns in a competitive road environment.

Wake Forest hosts Miami next before traveling to Louisville and welcoming Stanford , providing Lopez with three games that should preserve four-quarter volume. Miami represents a significant defensive test, but Louisville should force Wake Forest into aggressive offensive scripts with 35-plus pass-and-rush opportunities for Lopez. Stanford is the obvious streaming target at the end of the stretch. Lopez's combination of secure volume and goal-line rushing involvement makes him a viable QB streamer.

Craig torched Grambling State by completing 24-of-31 passes for 391 yards and four touchdowns without committing a turnover. The Harvard transfer also gained 53 rushing yards, combining for 36.9 fantasy points in TCU's 63-7 rout. Craig displayed legitimate vertical intent, connecting on touchdowns of 52 and 29 yards while repeatedly utilizing TEs Kari Ashley and Ka'Morreun Pimpton down the seams. His 31-yard scramble on a broken fourth-down play further reinforced the athletic component of his CFF profile.

Craig now hosts a CFF-friendly tilt against Arkansas State before beginning Big 12 play at UCF and returning home against BYU. Arkansas State supplies an enticing streaming matchup, while UCF and BYU should generate the competitive scripts needed to keep TCU's offense aggressive into the fourth quarter. Craig's 391-yard explosion must be discounted slightly because of the opponent, but the efficiency, downfield usage and rushing production are all transferable traits. He profiles as a strong speculative QB2 with major streaming potential.

The full-sized tailback seized control of Alabama 's backfield in Saturday's 45-17 victory over Kentucky , rushing 18 times for a career-high 104 yards and one touchdown. Hill generated 18.6 fantasy points and handled 18 of the Crimson Tide's 30 running-back carries, easily outdistancing Trae'shawn Brown, Kevin Riley and EJ Crowell. His 31-yard gain set up his own three-yard touchdown in the third quarter, providing the physical inside presence Alabama needed after trailing 17-13 at halftime. The fact that Hill received such a heavy workload in an SEC road game validates the performance far more than his two-touchdown eruption against an overmatched opponent like ECU the week prior.

Alabama hosts Florida State and South Carolina before visiting Mississippi State over the next three weeks. Those matchups are roughly on par with Kentucky, and the presence of three capable reserve backs prevents Hill from attaining true bell-cow status immediately. However, his 18-carry workload indicates that he has moved to the front of the rotation. Hill is a strong waiver-wire option coming off two consecutive 18+ point performances and should be treated as a workload-driven RB2/Flex.

Matt Fuller , South Carolina — 5% rostered

Fuller dialed up 125 yards and a touchdown on only 11 carries in South Carolina's rain-soaked 45-9 victory over Towson. His 55-yard touchdown highlighted a hyper-efficient outing in which he averaged 11.4 yards per attempt and scored 17.8 fantasy points. Fuller has now accumulated 199 yards and two touchdowns on 21 carries through two games, averaging a robust 9.5 yards per tote. The 221-pound runner was named South Carolina's Joe Morrison Offensive Player of the Spring, while QB LaNorris Sellers and WR Nyck Harbor both publicly praised his physical, north-south running style.

The looming schedule — Mississippi State, at Alabama and Ole Miss — will provide a far sterner examination of Fuller's role. South Carolina continues to rotate Jabree Coleman and Isaiah Augustave, while Sellers' rushing ability further complicates the distribution of goal-line work. However, Fuller's blend of size and explosiveness has become increasingly difficult for the coaching staff to contain. He is a worthwhile speculative add, though managers should initially value him as a matchup-dependent flex rather than an unquestioned starter until we see how he performs against SEC caliber opponents.

Fields surpassed 100 rushing yards for the second consecutive week during Kansas State 's 34-7 domination of Washington State . Fields supplied the game's defining offensive play with a 75-yard touchdown and scored 16.5 fantasy points, establishing himself as the most explosive member of the Wildcats' crowded backfield. Kansas State amassed 295 rushing yards on 40 attempts, with its offensive line consistently creating clean second-level opportunities. Fields' ability to generate chunk gains separates him from a rotation that also includes 2025 starting RB Joe Jackson .

Kansas State hosts Tulane before traveling to Cincinnati , two very appealing matchups for fantasy purposes. Keep in mind, he produced 890 scrimmage yards at Oklahoma State last season and has now translated that experience into consecutive 100-yard performances for the Wildcats. Fields is an ascending RB2/Flex play whose big-play capability makes him especially valuable in deeper leagues.

Illinois ' WR1 went off for 11 receptions, 166 yards and three touchdowns against Duke, producing a gaudy 40.1 fantasy points in one of Week 2's premier receiving performances. Dixon caught touchdowns from 40 yards and twice inside the red zone, including a two-yard score after his own 30-yard reception placed Illinois at the goal line. He now leads the Illini with 17 catches, 236 yards and five touchdowns through two games after recording 35 receptions for 548 yards and five scores across the entire 2025 season. His offseason work with QB Katin Houser has translated into immediate chemistry at every level of the field.

Dixon draws a tasty matchup against Southern Illinois next before traveling to Ohio State and hosting Purdue. The Southern Illinois matchup offers another eruption spot, while Ohio State represents an obvious downgrade that could nevertheless produce elevated target volume in comeback mode. Purdue then returns Dixon to a more appealing matchup in Week 5. His five touchdowns will regress, but the 17 receptions and established WR1 role make Dixon a priority waiver claim who should be started immediately.

Na'eem Abdul-Rahim Gladding delivered a definitive breakout against UConn , catching eight passes for 130 yards and one touchdown. The performance generated 23.0 fantasy points and followed a six-catch, 57-yard, one-touchdown opener, giving Gladding 14 receptions and two scores through his first two games at Maryland . QB Malik Washington completed 18 consecutive passes during the 38-14 victory, repeatedly exploiting UConn's man coverage through Gladding and Chris Durr Jr. Gladding's 14 targets and 100% catch rate through two games suggest his emergence is driven by a stable role rather than a fluky collection of deep connections.

Maryland hosts Virginia Tech and UCLA before an early-October bye. Virginia Tech's revamped defense presents a formidable test, but UCLA's lackluster Week 1 performance against Cal showed that its secondary can surrender both volume and explosive plays. More importantly, Maryland's faster spread offense is placing Washington in position to support multiple fantasy-relevant receivers. Gladding is a priority addition with immediate WR3 utility and the target profile to develop into a weekly WR2.

Joseph Williams , Colorado — 4% rostered

Williams reminded CFF managers of his game-breaking ability by catching four passes for 123 yards and two touchdowns in Colorado 's 52-21 victory over Weber State. The explosive performance equated to 26.3 fantasy points, with Williams averaging a staggering 30.8 yards per reception. He entered the season as a core returning starter after recording 37 receptions for 489 yards and four touchdowns in 2025, so this was an established contributor capitalizing on an expanded vertical role — not an unknown reserve accumulating garbage-time statistics. Williams' 6-foot-2, 200-pound frame also makes him Colorado's most natural boundary and contested-catch option complementing Danny Scudero and Texas transfer DeAndre Moore.

Colorado visits Northwestern and Baylor before hosting Texas Tech. Northwestern is an attractive matchup for maintaining Williams' momentum, while Baylor and Texas Tech possess the offensive firepower to create elevated passing volume and potential shootouts. His Week 2 efficiency is obviously unsustainable, so managers should focus more closely on whether the target volume rises against stronger opponents. Williams is a boom-oriented Flex option with enough potential to warrant a speculative claim.

The clear WR1 at Cincinnati, Gibson has scored a touchdown in each of his first two contests, recording 13.4 fantasy points in Week 1 vs. BC and 16.4 points in a comfortable win over WCU this weekend. Remember, he recorded 70 receptions for 1,215 yards and nine touchdowns during his 2024 All-American season at Arkansas-Pine Bluff, then flashed his scoring potential with three touchdown catches in Cincinnati's spring game.

Cincinnati faces Miami (Ohio), Kansas State and Iowa State over its next three games. Miami (OH) offers an appealing return spot, while the ensuing Big 12 contests should generate significantly more passing volume than Saturday's runaway victory. Gibson's elite pedigree and proven vertical production makes him worthy of a speculative add given the attractive matchups ahead.

Jaleel Skinner , Louisville — 1% rostered

Skinner caught two passes for 82 yards and a touchdown in Louisville's 59-13 rout of Villanova, producing 15.2 fantasy points. After dropping an earlier opportunity, Skinner responded with a 69-yard touchdown reception shortly before halftime, showcasing the field-stretching athleticism that once made him one of the nation's most coveted tight-end recruits. He helped QB Lincoln Kienholz finish with 332 passing yards and four total touchdowns. Skinner's ability to threaten vertically distinguishes him from the low-aDOT, touchdown-dependent options that typically populate CFF waiver wires.

Louisville hosts SMU and Wake Forest before traveling to NC State. Those three opponents should keep the Cardinals throwing far deeper into games than Villanova did, although Skinner must compete with Lawayne McCoy, Tre Richardson and the rest of Louisville's receiving corps. His two-target line warns against treating the Week 2 eruption as a secure-volume breakout. Skinner is a rising TE1 whose athletic upside makes him worth rostering in all formats.

articles.title: Spurs' Julian Champagnie buys $3.1M far Northwest Side home
articles.summary: The Spurs forward's new home in the luxury neighborhood comes about three months after he signed a three-year contract with the team.
articles.body:
Residents of The Dominion neighborhood in far Northwest San Antonio will soon be getting a new neighbor: Julian Champagnie .

The 25-year-old San Antonio Spurs forward bought a home listed for $3.1 million in the gated posh community off Interstate 10, outside Loop 1604, CultureMap San Antonio reported. The sale comes less than three months after Champagnie signed a $45 million three-year contract with the city's beloved NBA team after joining its ranks in 2023.

Set behind a guard-gated entrance, Champagnie's new one-story, ranch-style home features five beds and five and a half baths sprawled across 5,000 square feet on a half-acre lot, according to HAR.com, a real estate listing service.

The home's interior offers a "sophisticated palette of white oak flooring, marble, brick-laid porcelain tile, [and] exotic stone surfaces," according to the listing, which has been removed from the site.

Its entryway opens to a living room decorated in gray and beige with a floor-to-ceiling fireplace and tall glass windows overlooking a furnished outdoor seating area.

The home's kitchen boasts a large waterfall island and Thermador appliances, according to CultureMap, an online lifestyle news publication. Tucked behind it is a separate prep kitchen with an additional refrigerator, sink, oven, dishwasher and microwave. The home features a glass wine room, walk-in closets and a game room with a full wet bar. Sinks line both sides of the en-suite bathroom, which also includes a rain shower, garden tub and an armchair.

Backyard highlights include a patio, bath seating, a pool and a spa.

Champagnie's new zip code features luxury spas, fitness centers, fine dining and boutiques, according to HAR.com . Neighborhood residents can also access private golf courses, tennis courts and swimming pools in the area's country clubs.

"This opulent part of Texas is renowned for its grand residences, esteemed communities, and high-end facilities," the real estate site says.

Champagnie's new residence was constructed in 2021 by luxury building company Burdick Custom Homes and sold by Binkan Cinaroglu of Kuber Sotheby's International Realty.

articles.title: Raúl Varela: "Al final Lamine también ha enseñado la patita porque todos son iguales"
articles.standfirst: El presentador de La Tribu analiza las palabras del futbolista del Barcelona sobre el Balón de Oro y recuerda las críticas que recibió Mbappé
articles.summary: El presentador de La Tribu analiza las palabras del futbolista del Barcelona sobre el Balón de Oro y recuerda las críticas que recibió Mbappé
articles.body: Raúl Varela puso el foco en Lamine Yamal y el Balón de Oro después del adelanto del próximo capítulo de 'Universo Valdano', en el que el futbolista del Barcelona es protagonista. El periodista destacó especialmente la ambición del azulgrana por conquistar el premio individual. "Lamine dice su verdad y su verdad le hace considerarse el mejor del mundo", junto al delantero del Real Madrid Kylian Mbappé, señaló Varela en La Tribu. Además, repasó los argumentos deportivos del jugador: "Ha ganado la Liga, en gran medida por sus actuaciones, y el Mundial pese a su discreto papel". Por ello, "cree merecer más que nadie el trofeo más absurdo, deseado y criticado que se otorga en el ámbito del fútbol". Varela centró buena parte de su reflexión en la importancia que los propios futbolistas conceden a los reconocimientos individuales. "Al final también ha enseñado la patita porque todos son iguales, los jugadores me refiero", aseguró. "Mucho explicar que somos un equipo, que ganamos todos y que sin mis compañeros no sería posible, pero a la hora de la verdad solo ven un hueco en la vitrina de su casa para colocar un galardón que reporta un montón de cosas, entre ellas la vanidad de ser proclamado como el más destacado de la temporada", añadió. Una postura que Varela asegura haber terminado por aceptar: "Y ha dejado de parecerme mal. Forma parte del negocio. Reporta dinero, gloria, aura, que dicen los jóvenes". El periodista aprovechó el caso de Lamine para recordar las críticas que han recibido otros futbolistas por mostrar públicamente su deseo de conquistar el Balón de Oro. "Pido el favor a todos los moralistas del balón que no nos den más la turra cuando un jugador del Madrid, léase Kylian o el propio Vinicius, que se bajó de un avión por lo que consideró casi como un hurto de último minuto, se muestren exultantes o acaben en el diván de los deprimidos en función del resultado de según qué votaciones". Varela también puso sobre la mesa otras candidaturas: "Harry Kane hizo una gran temporada. Con números individuales y títulos. Con su selección y su club. Los goles de Mbappé ya los hemos contado, y casi cualquiera del PSG, el equipo hegemónico del momento, presenta argumentos para el oropel". Finalmente, regresó a Lamine Yamal para valorar sus opciones: "Lamine hizo una gran Liga. Un Mundial mediocre. En la Champions y en la Copa el Atleti lo borró del mapa a alturas muy tempranas. ¿Le da para ser el mejor? Pues ya lo veremos". Y cerró con una última reflexión sobre la siempre polémica votación del premio: "Al final le acabaremos echando la culpa al pobre votante de Burundi".

articles.title: Toros de hoy, lunes 14 de septiembre: quién torea, horarios y dónde ver en TV las corridas
articles.standfirst: La jornada taurina de este lunes 14 de septiembre despliega festejos en plazas destacadas de la Comunidad de Madrid y otros puntos de la geografía española
articles.summary: La jornada taurina de este lunes 14 de septiembre despliega festejos en plazas destacadas de la Comunidad de Madrid y otros puntos de la geografía española
articles.body: Los municipios madrileños como Arganda del Rey, Móstoles, Cadalso de los Vidrios, Algete, Cerceda, Ciempozuelos, Fuenlabrada, Fuentidueña de Tajo y Galapagar acogen festejos en el marco de sus fiestas patronales. Espadas de primer nivel y jóvenes novilleros buscarán triunfar en una jornada de intensa actividad taurina. En plazas como Móstoles destacan espadas como Sebastián Castella o Roca Rey frente a reses de Vellosino. Por su parte, la feria de Arganda del Rey presenta novillos de Concha y Sierra, conformando un menú taurino de enorme atractivo para los aficionados de la región. Los festejos vespertinos en las distintas plazas de toros madrileñas y del resto de la península arrancan habitualmente entre las 17:30 y las 18:30 horas. Resulta recomendable consultar las agendas locales de los consistorios para confirmar el inicio exacto en cada uno de los recintos. La retransmisión televisiva en directo se concentra principalmente en los canales autonómicos y las plataformas especializadas en streaming taurino. Cadenas como Telemadrid o Castilla-La Mancha Media suelen ofrecer cobertura de festejos regionales, mientras que plataformas de pago permiten seguir eventos destacados del calendario.

articles.title: El deporte femenino carga contra Sydney Sweeney: "Es una falta de respeto sexualizar cuerpos para un anuncio"
articles.standfirst: La actriz aparece sin ropa en una campaña publicitaria para una casa de apuestas deportivas
articles.summary: La actriz aparece sin ropa en una campaña publicitaria para una casa de apuestas deportivas
articles.body: Sydney Sweeney, la actriz que saltó a la fama tras su papel en la serie Euphoria y que recientemente ha protagonizado la adaptación cinematográfica del best seller La asistenta, se ha convertido en el punto de mira de numerosas deportistas que han criticado su campaña publicitaria para una empresa de apuestas. En ella, Sweeney aparece desnuda con escasa ropa mientras simula practicar varios deportes. La exnadadora olímpica Ariarne Titmus se mostró tajante en sus redes sociales por sexualizar el deporte femenino: "No puedo describir la rabia que siento al ver esto. No solo es una bofetada para todas las mujeres que han dedicado su vida a perfeccionar su oficio, sino para todas las mujeres que disfrutan del deporte por lo que realmente es: trabajo en equipo, amistad, dedicación, excelencia… Pensaba que este tipo de marketing "absurdo" era cosa del pasado". La gimnasta estadounidense Gracie Kramer dio un paso más y subió un vídeo a sus redes sociales en el que lanzaba un mensaje a Sydney Sweeney": Así es como luce una mujer en el deporte". El video encontró respuesta enseguida por parte de otras deportistas que incluyeron sus propios vídeos entrenando o compitiendo con otros mensajes. Fue el caso de la triatleta Jenna Gwinn: "El lugar de la mujer en la industria del deporte es como atleta, reportera, entrenadora.... No sexualizar cuerpos para un anuncio de apuestas deportivas dirigido a hombres. Las mujeres pertenecen a la industria del deporte sin ser sexualizadas". La nadadora olímpica australiana Lani Pallister, oro olímpico en París 2024 en el relevo 4x200, compartió otro video con sus entrenamientos, carreras y medallas con el mensaje: "No sé qué piensa Sydney sobre el deporte, pero así es como se ve el deporte". La waterpolista australiana Tilly Kearns, plata olímpica en París 2024, fue más allá. Escribió "odio absolutamente el nuevo anuncio deportivo de Sydney Sweeney" sobre un vídeo que muestras imágenes de sus partidos. La campeona mundial de boxeo, Skye Nicolson señalaba que "darle a la campaña publicitaria exactamente lo que querían, pero honestamente estas empresas necesitan hacerlo mejor. Dejen de sexualizar a las mujeres en el deporte". Su mensaje se unió al que había lanzado antes: "Hay una gran diferencia entre parecer ‘sexy’ porque haces deporte y usar el sexo para vender ‘deporte’. [...] Es una falta de respeto hacia las deportistas que dedican su vida al deporte y hacia las mujeres que han roto barreras durante generaciones, para luego ridiculizarlo usando un símbolo sexual con lenguaje e imágenes sugerentes en un anuncio sobre deporte". "Este anuncio es sinceramente indignante. Ver que lo deportes femeninos se comercializan una vez más a través de la mirada masculina se siente como un enorme paso atrás. No deberíamos tener que quitarnos la ropa para convencer a los hombres de que las mujeres pertenecen a los deportes o que sólo vale la pena mirarnos si mostramos suficiente piel", comentó la gimnasta mexicana Natalia Escalera. Sydney Sweeney también usó sus redes sociales para dar respuesta a estos comentarios. La actriz llenó sus stories de Instagrama de fotos de portadas con reconocidos deportistas que posaron desnudos para diversos reportajes. Entre esas imágenes se puede ver a Serena Williams, Ronda Rousey, Megan Rapinoe, Myles Garret...

articles.title: Hyrox revisará sus reglas tras permitir competir a la campeona del mundo cubierta en heces en Pekín
articles.standfirst: Joanna Wietrzyk, actual campeona del mundo, sufrió una incontinencia estomacal repentina mientras competía, pero finalizó la carrera y logró el primer lugar
articles.summary: Joanna Wietrzyk, actual campeona del mundo, sufrió una incontinencia estomacal repentina mientras competía, pero finalizó la carrera y logró el primer lugar
articles.body: La compañía alemana Hyrox, promotora de la competición deportiva que atrae a miles de personas en todo el mundo, revisará sus reglas tras el escándalo provocado este fin de semana en Pekín por una atleta australiana a la que se permitió finalizar la carrera, pese a que se encontraba cubierta de heces. Joanna Wietrzyk, actual campeona del mundo en su categoría, sufrió una incontinencia estomacal repentina el sábado mientras competía, pero finalizó la carrera y logró el primer lugar. El incidente, que se ha hecho viral en redes sociales, ha causado la indignación de numerosos aficionados a esta disciplina y editoriales de medios especializados que consideran que en un evento donde se penaliza escupir en la pista o verterse agua por encima, se dio un tratamiento especial a la deportista por su estatus de élite y porque está patrocinada por la firma Puma, que también es espónsor oficial de Hyrox. Wietrzyk publicó a posteriori en Instagram una fotografía suya en una camilla médica con el texto "una victoria es una victoria", pero posteriormente la borró, no sin antes recibir cientos de comentarios que cuestionaban su deportividad y le reprochaban no haberse retirado para no poner en riesgo la salud del resto de los participantes y de los trabajadores del recinto. "A medida que nuestro deporte evoluciona, encontramos situaciones nuevas y cada vez más complejas que suponen un reto y en las que es necesaria mayor claridad", indica un comunicado de la franquicia emitido este lunes, en el que también se asegura que Hyrox "aplica claros protocolos médicos y de biocontaminación". La nota indica que lo ocurrido el pasado sábado en la capital china fue "una situación inesperada en la que se desdibujaron los protocolos diseñados para la competición de élite y la competición masiva, creando ambigüedad en cómo se entendieron y aplicaron". "Reconocemos que esto puede, lógicamente, provocar frustración, preguntas y opiniones encendidas dentro de nuestra comunidad. Esas preocupaciones son legítimas y, como organizadores, debemos estar preparados para escucharlas, investigar lo ocurrido y responsabilizarnos para seguir mejorando", agrega. La compañía también lanzó una dura advertencia después de que supuestamente Wietrzyk recibiera amenazas en Internet y dijo que está investigando y prohibirá a los responsables la entrada a futuros eventos. Una participante que compitió el día del incidente y vio en directo lo ocurrido afirmó a EFE que la situación fue tal y como recogen las imágenes que circulan en las redes sociales: la atleta sufrió una fuerte incontinencia a menos de la mitad de la carrera pero permaneció en la competición, manchando a su paso con heces la pista de carreras y el equipamiento, máquinas y alfombras compartidos con el resto de los deportistas. "La limpieza no se realizó en ese momento, sino al final del día, y hubo personas que se mancharon e incluso resbalaron por las heces", señaló la testigo. También el diario oficialista chino Global Times se hace este lunes eco de la polémica, y cita al comentarista deportivo Zhu Meng: "La verdadera deportividad se trata de saber dónde trazar la línea, porque la competición nunca debe continuar a expensas de la salud pública y los derechos de otros atletas", señaló. Igualmente las redes sociales chinas han reaccionado con indignación, cuestionando por qué los organizadores y el equipo médico no actuaron a tiempo, a la vez que participantes de esa misma jornada aseguraban que lo correcto sería que Hyrox reembolsara el dinero -unos 150 dólares por participante- a las personas que compitieron a la vez que la australiana y se vieron expuestos a riesgos sanitarios. Hyrox es una competición deportiva creada en 2017 que intercala ocho kilómetros de carrera con otros tantos ejercicios de fuerza con el objetivo de completarlo en el menor tiempo posible, se celebra en recintos de más de 20 países y cuya franquicia estaba valorada al cierre de 2025 en más de 600 millones de euros, según la revista Forbes.

articles.title: Un conductor multiplica por cuatro la tasa de alcohol y echa la culpa al vinagre del gazpacho
articles.standfirst: El conductor habría cometido un delito contra la seguridad vial y se enfrentaría a la retirada del carné de conducir durante un plazo de entre uno y cuatro años.
articles.summary: El conductor habría cometido un delito contra la seguridad vial y se enfrentaría a la retirada del carné de conducir durante un plazo de entre uno y cuatro años.
articles.body: Por mucho que policías y guardias civiles estén acostumbrados a escuchar excusas 'originales' cuando dan el alto a un vehículo, lo que han vivido miembros de la Policía Local de Castilleja de la Cuesta (Sevilla) entra dentro del esperpento. Los hechos sucedieron en la madrugada del 6 de septiembre, aunque no ha sido hasta estos días cuando se han hecho públicos. Según ha informado la policía en sus canales de redes sociales, una patrulla vio cómo un conductor realizaba maniobras extrañas al volante, tras lo cual comprobaron que estaba usando el teléfono móvil al volante y no llevaba el cinturón de seguridad puesto. Ante la evidencia de que el conductor arrojaba síntomas propios del consumo de alcohol, fue sometido a un test que dio un resultado de 1 mg por litro de aire espirado, cuando el máximo permitido es 0,25 y por encima de 0,60 ya se considera delito penal. La excusa que entonces lanzó el conductor es que solo había tomado gazpacho, pero que el vinagre que se utiliza para hacer este plato sería el responsable de que le subiera el alcohol en sangre. Por supuesto, su razonamiento no impidió que la policía continuara con su trabajo y formulara una denuncia por un presunto delito contra la seguridad vial. Ahora, el autor de semejante tropelía se enfrenta a penas de prisión de tres a seis meses y multa de seis a doce meses, si bien esta última puede ser cambiada por trabajos en beneficio de la comunidad de 31 a 90 días. De ser declarado culpable como es previsible, a ello se añadiría la retirada del carné de conducir por un plazo de entre uno y cuatro años.

articles.title: WWE Rumors on Roman Reigns vs. Oba Femi, Bayley's Contract and New Women's Tag Team Eyed
articles.summary: Bleacher Report catches you up on the latest news from the WWE Universe.
articles.body:
Bleacher Report catches you up on the latest news from the WWE Universe.

Rumored WrestleMania 43 Main Event Plans

WrestleMania 43 in April 2027 is still months away, but it sounds like there's already an idea for the headlining match for the two-night marquee event in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

Per Geno Mrosko of Cageside Seats, Dave Meltzer reported in the Wrestling Observer Newsletter that the expectation is for WWE to build toward having Roman Reigns defend the World Heavyweight Championship against Oba Femi in the main event of WrestleMania 43 Night 2. Meltzer noted that plans can change between now and then, but the initial idea is for Reigns and Femi to close the show.

There are many different directions that WWE can go to have Femi take on Reigns, who defeated CM Punk for the World Heavyweight title in the WrestleMania 42 Night 2 main event this past April. Reigns cut a promo calling out Femi after his title win, setting an early stage for their eventual showdown.

Femi already passed up a title shot against Reigns after winning the King of the Ring tournament to settle his rivalry with Brock Lesnar. The rising young Superstar could be the favorite to win the men's Royal Rumble in January.

While the plan isn't set in stone, Reigns vs. Femi is a highly anticipated heavyweight clash that fans will surely be excited to see.

Many have been wondering about Bayley's future in WWE, but it sounds like she won't be going anywhere anytime soon.

According to Dave Meltzer in the Wrestling Observer Newsletter (h/t Mrosko ), while Bayley has not yet signed a new deal with WWE, it appears that she agreed to terms with the company a few weeks back, and it's expected that she will sign a new contract eventually.

Bayley was off TV for a few weeks, leading many to wonder if she was departing WWE when her contract expired. However, she returned from her hiatus during the Sept. 7 episode of Monday Night Raw.

According to Meltzer, it was after Bayley agreed to terms on a new deal that WWE "started treating her like a member of the roster again" by mentioning her in storylines in the weeks leading up to her return.

Bayley is one of the most beloved Superstars in WWE, and it appears that she will remain a cornerstone of the women's division for years to come.

WWE is reportedly considering a new pairing between two Superstars who haven't built much momentum this year.

According to a report from False Finish (h/t Mrosko ), there have been "creative discussions regarding a potential team of Ivy Nile and Jordynne Grace," both of whom have been off television in recent weeks.

Nile was previously a member of the American Made faction, though she mostly worked as a valet and didn't wrestle much. Grace debuted on the main roster in January, but an ankle injury derailed her initial push.

Mrosko also noted that WWE filed to trademark "Iron Built," matching similar filings for wrestler or faction names and catchphrases. Nile and Grace are known for their bodybuilding prowess and impressive physiques.

After breaking up Paige from the Bella Twins, WWE needs new tag teams to challenge Fatal Influence, who won the tag titles in July. Pairing Grace and Nile together could give new opportunities to Superstars who have struggled to get over as singles competitors.

articles.title: Ludek Miklosko cause of death: How did West Ham’s former “inspirational” goalkeeper die
articles.summary: International Sports News: Former West Ham United and QPR goalkeeper Ludek Miklosko has died at the age of 64. The Czech goalkeeper was one of the most loved figures among West .
articles.body: Former West Ham United and QPR goalkeeper Ludek Miklosko has died at the age of 64. The Czech goalkeeper was one of the most loved figures among West Ham supporters and remained closely connected with the club even after his playing career ended.Miklosko spent eight years with West Ham after joining from Baník Ostrava in 1990. He made 373 appearances for the club and later returned as a goalkeeping coach. His performances, personality and connection with the fans made him a memorable figure in the club’s history.Ludek Miklosko cause of death Ludek Miklosko has passed away after a long battle with cancer. Miklosko was diagnosed with cancer in 2021. In December 2024, he announced that he was withdrawing from cancer treatment. Despite his illness, he continued to maintain a strong connection with West Ham.West Ham confirmed his death in a statement. “It is with deep and profound sadness that West Ham United announces the passing of legendary former goalkeeper and coach, Ludek Miklosko. Rest in peace Ludek, our beloved, inspirational goalkeeper and gentle giant of a man.”West Ham said Miklosko would “for ever hold a special place in the hearts of the West Ham family”. The club will hold a period of appreciation for him before their Carabao Cup match against Fulham and dedicate their October 9 home Championship game against QPR to his memory.Inside Ludek Miklosko’s West Ham legacyLudek Miklosko joined West Ham in 1990 after a trial. The club paid around £300,000 ($400,000) to sign him from Baník Ostrava. He quickly became an important part of the team.In his first full season, Miklosko helped West Ham win promotion to the old First Division in 1990-91. The club also reached the FA Cup semi-finals that season. His performances earned him the Hammer of the Year award.Miklosko remained at West Ham until 1998. During his time at the club, he made 373 appearances. Supporters affectionately called him ‘Ludo’ and regularly sang his name during matches.One of the most famous moments of his career came on the final day of the 1994-95 season. West Ham drew 1-1 with Manchester United. United needed a victory to finish top of the Premier League, but the result allowed Blackburn Rovers to win the title.After leaving West Ham, Miklosko joined QPR. He initially moved to the club on loan before making the transfer permanent. He had 57 league appearances for QPR between 1998 and 2001 before retiring from professional football.His connection with West Ham did not end with his playing career. Miklosko returned to the club as a goalkeeping coach and worked there until 2010. He later worked for a sports agency before returning to Baník Ostrava in different roles, including board member and sporting director.Miklosko also enjoyed a respected international career. articles.title: Predictions For Roman Reigns vs. Penta WWE World Championship Match on Raw
articles.summary: WWE continues its stay in Mexico City Monday night on Raw, with a blockbuster broadcast of the company's flagship show headlined by Roman Reigns defending the World Heavyweight Championship against Penta.
articles.body:
WWE continues its stay in Mexico City Monday night on Raw, with a blockbuster broadcast of the company's flagship show headlined by Roman Reigns defending the World Heavyweight Championship against Penta.

A match of this magnitude is typically reserved for premium live events, so what can fans expect when The Tribal Chief clashes with Cero Miedo south of the border?

Find out in this preview for the marquee match-up, including the argument for each Superstar leaving the country with the coveted prize.

WWE is once again in the thick of The Bloodline Saga, setting up what appears to be a long-term storyline involving Reigns as champion and his cousins, The Usos and Jacob Fatu, as his minions.

While the story feels significantly less compelling than the original, there appears to be a concentrated effort to elevate Fatu into the realm of consistent main eventers. For that reason, Reigns must retain his title and continue to tell that story.

Especially if there is any semblance of a chance that The Rock returns to finally set up that long-awaited, one-on-one clash with The OTC.

Raw is a stagnant brand right now, one that feels repetitive and uninspired, even more so when Reigns does not appear on the flagship.

Meanwhile, Penta is a fresh addition to the top of the card, a luchador who has been over with audiences from day one, has undeniable chemistry, has proven himself in high-profile matches, and could easily run with the title.

In fact, he would be the first first-time champion to hold the top prize on Monday nights since Jey Uso defeated Gunther for the title at WrestleMania 41, over 17 months ago.

Putting the title on Penta would give the creative team a fresh champion to promote. It would also create an unforgettable moment in Mexico City, where he could celebrate with the people who have supported him since the beginning of his career.

For a show that needs a shot of adrenaline entering the back quarter of the year, a Penta coronation is exactly what it needs.

The company crowned a new Undisputed WWE Champion on Friday night as Sami Zayn defeated CM Punk to take the gold. It followed that up on Sunday with El Grande Americano finally besting Dominik Mysterio and capturing the AAA Mega Championship.

The table is set for the most notable title change yet: a Penta victory that creates a new main event star, gives the fans the most unforgettable title changes yet, and provides Raw with a consistently appearing champion.

Unfortunately, Raw is where the momentous victories end.

There is a snowball's chance in Arizona that the creative team interrupts the latest incarnation of The Bloodline in the middle of a feud with Royce Key's 946 faction, with LA Knight jockeying for a title shot, and takes the title off of Reigns.

The Tribal Chief and The Bloodline are a safety blanket for them and, regardless of whether it hits as it used to or not, it is the overarching story on the brand.

Could interference from Knight or Keys' trio set up the title change? Sure, but it would weaken Penta and create unnecessary controversy for his first world championship victory.

Neither he nor the top of the card needs that considering how much the same story has been at the center of the SmackDown main event scene for months.

Reigns wins, retains his title, but in a way that puts Penta over as a legitimate challenger and earns The OTC's respect.

articles.title: Conor Benn opens up on “What’s Next” after crushing Ryan Garcia WBC welterweight title defeat in Las Vegas
articles.summary: International Sports News: Conor Benn is facing an uncertain future after suffering a damaging stoppage defeat against Ryan Garcia in Las Vegas. The British boxer was stopped in.
articles.body: Conor Benn is facing an uncertain future after suffering a damaging stoppage defeat against Ryan Garcia in Las Vegas. The British boxer was stopped in the second round at the T-Mobile Arena while chasing the WBC welterweight title and another major step in his career.The loss was a major setback for Benn, who had hoped to follow in the footsteps of his father, former world champion Nigel Benn. However, the 29-year-old has now made it clear that boxing is not his immediate priority. Instead, he plans to spend time with his family before deciding on his next move.Conor Benn plans family time before boxing returnConor Benn admitted that he does not yet know what his next move will be after the painful defeat.Taking to his social media, he wrote, “Everybody keeps asking: ‘What’s next for Conor Benn?’” he stated on social media. “The truth is, I don’t have the answer. If you’d asked the 19-year-old version of me whether I thought I’d be standing here 10 years later, having lived through everything I have, I’d have told you that you were crazy.”He continued, “I train hard. I sacrifice. I’ve given this game 110 per cent every time I’ve stepped through those ropes, I’ve wanted to give people unforgettable nights and entertain. That’s what this has always been about for me. People spend their hard-earned money to come and watch guys like us fight. I’ve never taken that for granted.”Benn is expected to take some time away from the sport. His immediate focus appears to be recovering from the defeat and spending more time with his children.He added, “Giving everything comes at a cost. And the people who have paid that cost more than anyone are my family and my kids. They’ve sacrificed time with their dad so I could chase this dream. They’ve had to share me with this sport their entire lives. So when people ask me what’s next for Conor Benn, right now the answer is simple. Time with my kids.”He also thanked his supporters who travelled to Las Vegas and stayed awake to watch the fight.Despite the defeat, Benn is still only 29 and has plenty of time to rebuild his career. The Garcia fight was his first bout at welterweight in more than four years. He had previously competed twice against Chris Eubank Jr at middleweight.The return to 147 pounds was therefore a significant challenge for Benn. His next move could involve returning to a higher weight class rather than attempting another difficult welterweight run.A move to middleweight could provide him with fresh opportunities. Benn could potentially target established fighters at 160 pounds if he is able to work his way back into title contention.Another option could be a third fight with Eubank Jr. The pair are currently level at 1-1 after their two previous encounters. A trilogy at 168 pounds could also remove some of the pressure associated with making middleweight.For now, however, Benn appears ready to step away from boxing for some time. The Garcia defeat was a major blow, but his career is far from over. When he is ready to return, there should still be several routes available to him.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Sydney Sweeney under fire from athletes over nude sports-prediction ad
articles.summary: Female athletes have reacted with anger and incredulity to a “hypersexualized” advertising campaign featuring a nude or minimally clad Sydney Sweeney posing with sports equipment.
articles.body: Female athletes have reacted with anger and incredulity to a “hypersexualized” advertising campaign featuring a nude or minimally clad Sydney Sweeney posing with sports equipment. The campaign, for US sports-prediction market Novig, is “very damaging” for female athletes and young girls looking to get into sport, Australian surfer Felicity Palmateer told CNN in an interview Monday. In a series of photos and videos released Wednesday, Sweeney can be seen naked or scantily clad, holding American footballs, a tennis racket or a baseball bat. In one shot, she lies naked on top of a basketball. Novig also posted an ad on its Instagram reels, which has racked up 37 million views in four days. Palmateer was one of many female athletes to criticize the campaign. “Just absolute utter disbelief, incredibly disappointing, like, how far you can put women’s sports backwards in the space of a 42-second commercial,” she said to CNN, adding that the campaign “is very damaging, especially for young females getting into sport, for females in sport, for females in general, just hypersexualized content.” “We want to be valued for what we can do, not what we look like,” Palmateer added. Australian four-time Olympic swimmer Ariarne Titmus posted a response to the campaign on her Instagram stories. “I wasn’t going to share this as I didn’t want to give this any more attention. But I can’t keep my mouth shut,” she said, according to CNN affiliate 9News. “I can’t describe how infuriated I feel when I watch this,” Titmus wrote. “Not only is this a kick in the face to every woman who has dedicated her life to perfecting her craft, but every woman who enjoys sports for what it really is — teamwork, friendship, dedication, excellence, unity … the list goes on.” Australian swimmer Lani Pallister was another of the athletes to hit back, posting a compilation video of her training and competing, with an overlay that reads: “Don’t know what Sydney thinks sport looks like, but THIS is what sport looks like.” Fellow Australian, boxer Skye Nicholson, posted a similar video in response to the ad. “Giving the ad campaign exactly what they wanted, but honestly these companies need to do better 🙄 Stop sexualising women in #sport,” reads the caption. Sweeney appeared to respond to the backlash Sunday by posting a series of photos from ESPN The Magazine’s annual “Body Issue.” The yearly edition featured dozens of athletes either naked or semi-nude during an 11-year run that came to an end in 2019. This is not the first time that Sweeney’s involvement in an advertising campaign has caused controversy. In summer 2025, she featured in a campaign for US clothing brand American Eagle, which some claimed promoted eugenics and White supremacism. “Genes are passed down from parents to offspring,” she says in one ad. In another, she claims that “my body’s composition is determined by my genes.” Sweeney didn’t initially address the uproar caused by the campaign, causing people to draw their own conclusions on how she felt about the ad. Then, in November, GQ magazine published an on-camera interview asking Sweeney about the fallout. Sweeney responded by saying she was surprised by the reaction, but she didn’t apologize, instead reiterating her love for jeans and her stance that she’s not there to tell people what to think. When asked if she wanted to set the record straight on her intention, the star replied with the now-viral soundbite: “I think that when I have an issue I want to speak about, people will hear.” CNN has contacted Sweeney’s representatives and Novig for comment.

articles.title: ‘It’s An Incredible Feeling’ – Yod-IQ Reflects On His World Title Win Over Rambolek At The Inner Circle 30
articles.summary: The Thai striking star reflects on his grueling five-round World Title victory over Rambolek last week.
articles.body:
A newly minted ONE Bantamweight Muay Thai World Champion has officially arrived, and Yod-IQ Or Pimolsri intends to stay.

The Thai striking star achieved his lifelong dream by securing a hard-fought unanimous decision over Rambolek Chor Ajalaboon in the main event of The Inner Circle 30 . The card streamed exclusively for subscribers at live.onefc.com in Asia primetime this past Friday, September 11, from Bangkok's revered Lumpinee Stadium.

For an athlete who has chased this elusive prize his entire life, the sheer magnitude of the moment has not fully sunk in.

Accolades of this caliber are forged through years of quiet sacrifice, long before the arena lights turn on, and the PK Saenchai Muaythaigym representative carries that profound journey with him every time he looks at the gold now resting around his waist.

"As a kid, I told my parents I wanted to be a World Champion. Even though I didn't even know what a World Title belt looked like back then. All I knew was that I wanted to achieve it. "To now see the World Title right in front of me, and have it wrapped around my own waist…it's an incredible feeling."

"As a kid, I told my parents I wanted to be a World Champion. Even though I didn't even know what a World Title belt looked like back then. All I knew was that I wanted to achieve it.

"To now see the World Title right in front of me, and have it wrapped around my own waist…it's an incredible feeling."

That golden dream did not come easily. He had to battle fiercely across five demanding rounds against one of the toughest fighters in the world to make it a reality, and the contest was far from one-sided in the early stages.

Rambolek pushed an intense pace through the opening three frames, landing his share of heavy artillery and forcing his fellow Thai to work for every inch. This was a suffocating brand of pressure, and the Superbon Training Camp product made sure Yod-IQ felt every ounce of it.

However, by the time the championship rounds arrived, the challenger showcased his superior conditioning, pulling away down the pivotal final stretch to seal his triumph on the judges' scorecards.

"[After three rounds], I still felt it was 50/50. As the challenger facing an established champion, you don't take anything for granted. Champions hold their ground, so I knew I couldn't relax. "But I think the last two rounds proved that I can take a shot without getting dropped. Once I survived the middle rounds on my feet, I knew I had done enough to secure the win. I felt I took almost every round. Whenever a round felt close, I made sure to push the pace hard at the end to seal it."

"[After three rounds], I still felt it was 50/50. As the challenger facing an established champion, you don't take anything for granted. Champions hold their ground, so I knew I couldn't relax.

"But I think the last two rounds proved that I can take a shot without getting dropped. Once I survived the middle rounds on my feet, I knew I had done enough to secure the win. I felt I took almost every round. Whenever a round felt close, I made sure to push the pace hard at the end to seal it."

The monumental victory extended Yod-IQ's winning streak to 11 and pushed his impressive career record to 128-36. It also made him the fourth man to wear the divisional crown since bantamweight kickboxing king Jonathan "The General" Haggerty dethroned longtime titleholder Nong-O Hama via first-round knockout in April 2023.

That specific lineage carries a restless reputation, with whispers suggesting the belt rarely stays with one man for long. The new king, however, is having none of it.

"I don't believe in curses – I believe in myself. I'm going to hold onto this belt longer than anyone else."

Yod-IQ Feels The Grind, Eyes His Next Challenger

Winning the gold was a massive achievement, but adjusting to the immense physical demands of a five-round World Championship bout under ONE Championship's rules proved to be an entirely different test.

The searing pace and intensity required across a 15-minute battle in four-ounce gloves differs wildly from the shorter sprints that defined Yod-IQ Or Pimolsri's earlier promotional run. Getting his conditioning perfectly tuned for that massive leap is already at the forefront of his mind heading into his eventual first title defense.

"It's completely different. You need a massive amount of endurance, which means training much harder. Three-round fights are exhausting enough as it is, but going five rounds at a non-stop pace requires a whole extra level of stamina."

With the undisputed gold now secured around his waist, Yod-IQ has already started looking ahead, making it crystal clear he has absolutely no plans to take his foot off the gas.

The PK Saenchai athlete holds no interest in hand-picking his opposition, happily leaving those decisions entirely to the promotion's matchmakers.

"Whoever Chatri [Sityodtong] sets up for me, I'm ready. I don't think an immediate rematch is on the table just yet, so I'll likely face someone else first. "I'm sure there's a long line of contenders waiting for me. [They can] line up and take their turn. We'll definitely meet in the ring when the time comes."

articles.title: Mohammad Rizwan opens up on being probed by the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency after England series
articles.summary: After he was probed by Pakistan's National Cyber Crime agency following his return, Mohammad Rizwan opened up about his experience with the investigation.
articles.body:
Mohammad Rizwan says he is fully cooperating with the NCCIA investigation.

The probe reportedly concerns alleged dressing-room leaks and issues from Pakistan's England tour.

Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq's mobile phone data is being examined as part of the inquiry.

Mohammad Rizwan opens up on being probed by the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency

Mohammad Rizwan has broken his silence on the investigation that has followed him home from a chastening tour of England, confirming he is cooperating fully with Pakistan's National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency and awaiting the outcome before he says anything further publicly.

Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq were among the seven players sent back to Pakistan by the PCB after the second Test defeat at Lord's, and both were subsequently summoned to the NCCIA's Lahore office, where they were questioned for around two hours.

According to Samaa TV, the investigation concerns allegations of information being leaked from Pakistan's dressing room, alongside separate matters connected to the England tour.

What Mohammad Rizwan said about the cybercrime probe

Rizwan kept his comments brief, indicating he would prefer to wait until the process has concluded before addressing the matter in full.

"I am fully cooperating with the investigation. I am waiting for the investigation to be completed," Rizwan told Samaa TV, adding that he could address the media once the inquiry is finished.

A separate Geo News report stated that the agency is reviewing financial transactions belonging to both players as part of the same investigation, examining their mobile phone data for any evidence of wrongdoing.

Why Rizwan and Imam were already under scrutiny before the probe

The investigation follows a broader reckoning within Pakistan cricket after seven players, including Rizwan and Imam, were removed from the squad mid-tour. A show-cause notice was separately issued to the PCB's selection committee, asking why the pair had been picked for the tours of the West Indies and England in the first place.

Rizwan's form had declined sharply across both tours, managing just 41 runs in two Tests in the West Indies before returning only 61 runs across four innings in the two England Tests that preceded his removal.

That marked a steep fall from his standing before the West Indies tour, when he had been Pakistan's leading run-scorer since January 2024. PCB chairman Mohsin Naqvi had hinted at factors beyond cricketing form driving the squad overhaul when the changes were first announced.

"We have had a discussion to ascertain the reasons behind it. They include factors beyond performance, and we will get to the bottom of it," Naqvi said at the time.

Pakistan's tour ultimately ended in a 3-0 whitewash, with defeats by an innings and 103 runs at Headingley, 194 runs at Lord's and eight wickets at Edgbaston, leaving Babar Azam's side bottom of the World Test Championship standings.

Why the investigation adds a troubling layer to an already chaotic tour

Whatever the outcome, the involvement of a cybercrime agency rather than the standard cricketing or anti-corruption channels continues to raise more questions than it answers.

Rizwan's calm, minimal public response is a sensible way to handle an ongoing legal matter, but it does little to clarify what specifically is being investigated or why financial transactions and phone data have become central to a probe that began as a conversation about squad selection.

Until the NCCIA or the PCB offers a clearer account of what the inquiry has actually uncovered, Pakistan cricket remains stuck between two unresolved stories, a Test whitewash that exposed genuine cricketing failures, and an investigation whose scope still has not been properly explained to the public.

articles.title: Falcons Offense Looks Broken After Week 1 Loss
articles.summary: The Falcons lost 20-13 to the Steelers in a Week 1 disaster. Between Cooper Rush's back spasms and a lack of passing, the offense is in serious trouble.
articles.body:
The Atlanta Falcons started the season with a 20-13 loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers , and it was an absolute mess. It is hard to even call this a football game when the offense looks this lost. We are watching a team that cannot move the ball, and it is making the season feel over before it even started.

The quarterback situation is a total joke. According to AJC.com , the team had to start Cooper Rush but he dealt with back spasms the day before the game. You cannot win games when your signal-caller is physically compromised. Rush struggled immensely, finishing the day with a passer rating that barely stayed above 50. He threw two interceptions and simply could not connect with his receivers. Yahoo Sports reported that the offense was a "one-man show" focused on Bijan Robinson . That is a massive problem for any team trying to compete in this league.

The only bright spot in this ugly performance was Bijan Robinson. While the rest of the group struggled, Robinson found some rhythm in the second half. Yahoo Sports noted that Robinson finished with 83 rushing yards on 21 attempts. He even scored the team's first touchdown of the year on a catch and run. But one star is not enough to fix a broken system. Late in the second quarter, Drake London finally received his first target. If the stars are not even getting the ball, the coaching staff is failing.

The defense actually played well enough to win, but they were undone by mistakes. The unit held Aaron Rodgers to 5.5 yards per attempt and recorded two sacks via Za'Darius Smith, according to Yahoo Sports. However, A.J. Terrell had a nightmare game in coverage. He took two major penalties in the first half, including a pass interference call that moved the Steelers into field goal range. Terrell also had to leave the game after a play where he hit DK Metcalf 's arms early. The Falcons were outgained 264-238, and that lack of discipline is going to haunt the team against the Panthers next week.

articles.title: Bucs news: Baker Mayfield laments strange problem during Bengals loss
articles.summary: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers got off on the wrong foot in Week 1 against the Cincinnati Bengals at Paycor Stadium, losing 33-27 in a game that saw them fall behi...
articles.body:
The Tampa Bay Buccaneers got off on the wrong foot in Week 1 against the Cincinnati Bengals at Paycor Stadium, losing 33-27 in a game that saw them fall behind 14-3 after the first quarter. Mayfield and the Buccaneers fumbled four times, including one near the goal line from Mayfield that caused frustration.

A brilliant, NFL history making play from Josiah Trotter on defense couldn't save coach Todd Bowles ' Bucs from the inevitable as his team was forced to accept a tough luck opening week loss. Afterward, his QB, Mayfield, described a strange problem that plagued him in the huddle and may have contributed to the funny feeling that came over his team and led to mistakes.

"We had some headset issues for quite a while, in and out. It's not an excuse, but when they're testing them on the sidelines, and they work fine. Then you get out in between the hashes, and it's not working, that's unfortunate," Mayfield said in a press conference.

Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial)

"But it wasn't the whole time, just kind of the first drive for sure and then sporadically throughout the rest of the game but yeah, we need to get in and out of the huddle quicker."

Mayfield was efficient, throwing the ball, completing 23-of-28 passes for 216 yards. Bucky Irving spearheaded a solid rushing attack with eight rushes for 45 yards and a touchdown. Irving also contributed in the passing game, where Emeka Egbuka starred with five catches for 63 yards.

The Bucs are capable of being far more explosive and far more cautious with the football on offense, but plenty has to change leading up to Week 2. Coach Bowles' team is too smart and too hard-nosed to turn the ball over four times on fumbles alone, which is sure to be an emphasis in practice this week, along with the technology glitch that hurt Mayfield and the Bucs in the weirdest way.

articles.title: Oregon, Ohio State and… oh, Purdue: Recapping a disastrous Week 2 for Big Ten football
articles.summary: Ohio State’s collapse, Michigan’s turnaround, Purdue’s… Purdue and more from Week 2 of Big Ten football in 2026.
articles.body:
The Big Ten has had its time in the sun with three consecutive national championships.

But oh man, there was a reckoning to be had this past weekend. The conference, which weeks ago seemed to be relishing its newfound primacy, now stands on its heels with losses to ACC, Big 12 and SEC teams with a near-miss against the zombie Pac-12.

Ohio State's losses under Ryan Day, few as they may be, have a few concerning parallels. Said parallels were on full display during the Buckeyes' collapse at Texas on Saturday.

The Buckeyes, entering the fourth quarter with a 23-3 lead, allowed 21 unanswered points to the Longhorns in the final frame as the offense went stagnant and the defense allowed Arch Manning to get comfortable enough to lead Texas all the way down the field.

Does this kind of loss knock Ohio State out of the national championship race, let alone the Big Ten? No, we've seen the Buckeyes come back from worse. Does it cause plenty of angst for the scarlet and gray faithful that these kinds of games keep happening under Day? Absolutely.

Indiana faces Ohio State on October 17 in Bloomington.

This though? That could very well be it for Oregon in 2026.

The Ducks got got by the same Oklahoma State team that dropped its season opener to Tulsa 24-10. The same program they beat 69-3 just last year, albeit during Mike Gundy's ill-fated final years leading the Cowboys.

Oregon could still come back from this, for sure, anything's possible. But Dan Lanning replacing his two star coordinators with internal hires rather than seeking outside ideas is looking an awful lot like a poor decision here early.

Illinois in 2026 is pretty far from what it was in 2025, when the Fighting Illini appeared set for perhaps their strongest season under Bret Bielema.

Still, losing to Duke at home like this has to sting. The Illini got the better of the Blue Devils on the road last year before the drubbing against Indiana and seemed set for a similar result before a second half rally saw them take the lead in the fourth quarter and never look back.

Illinois has room to grow, but there's gonna be pains with a new system on defense and an offense unable to stop the game from getting out of control.

The Boilermakers haven't won a game against a power conference opponent since 2023. That opponent was Indiana, then coached by Tom Allen in his final game leading the program. Purdue has one less coach during the ensuring two seasons and a game than it has points against Indiana during that same stretch.

It looked like Saturday could be it for Purdue with overtime giving the Boilers a real shot to put Wake Forest in the dirt before they got introduced themselves.

Minnesota let Mississippi State travel all the way up the titular river just to get rocked by the Bulldogs in its own house.

That's 38-13, man. That's a drubbing. Kamario Taylor is perhaps the most fun watch in the sport and torched the Gophers through the air for 227 yards and three touchdowns.

Washington needed to intercept a Hail Mary to hold on against a Utah State team coming off of a season-opening 29-17 loss to FCS Idaho State. That's as close to a loss as a win gets, thematically.

So that's that in a really rough week for the Big Te- oh wait!

The Michigan Wolverines , they of the Mystery Second and the Secret Clock against Western Michigan in Week 1, nabbed the most impressive win of any Big Ten team on the young season with Saturday's 17-10 victory over Oklahoma in Ann Arbor.

The Sooners were a playoff team in 2025 and were/are looking to get back there in 2026, having beaten Michigan down in Norman last season. The Wolverines were able to stay in front by a narrow margin throughout the contest before a Sooners field goal made it 10-10 early in the fourth quarter. An interception by Oklahoma quarterback John Mateer set Michigan up in prime scoring territory, and it took advantage in the redzone with a pair of runs to score and retake the lead, which proved ultimate.

Michigan went from a pretty embarrassing win to the only win worth talking about in just a week.

articles.title: ESPN Expert Reveals ‘Considerable Hype’ Surrounding Commanders QB Jayden Daniels
articles.summary: Jayden Daniels is entering the 2026 NFL season with a major opportunity to restore his standing among the league’s top young quarterbacks, and ESPN analyst J...
articles.body:
Jayden Daniels is entering the 2026 NFL season with a major opportunity to restore his standing among the league's top young quarterbacks, and ESPN analyst Jeremy Fowler believes there is considerable optimism surrounding his potential rebound. The Washington Commanders quarterback has reportedly remained a major topic in league circles as teams prepare for another competitive NFC East campaign.

Fowler's assessment suggests that Daniels has not been written off despite the setbacks that interrupted his progress. Instead, the expectation is that he can reclaim the form that made him one of the NFL's most exciting emerging stars and once again become a difficult matchup for opposing defenses.

The excitement is rooted in the quarterback's unique skill set. Daniels combines arm talent, mobility and improvisational ability, giving Washington an offensive centerpiece capable of changing games both inside and outside the pocket.

A return to his earlier level would be significant for the Commanders. When Daniels is playing with confidence and operating efficiently, the offense gains a dynamic dimension that forces defenses to account for his running threat while still respecting his ability to attack downfield.

ESPN Expert Reveals 'Considerable Hype' Surrounding Washington Commanders Star Jayden Daniels

There is a lot of positive talk surrounding Daniels this season. This is detailed more in an analysis by Jeremy Fowler for ESPN.

But he isn't the only QB on the comeback trail. Jayden Daniels can reclaim his place as a premier quarterback, and there's considerable hype in league circles that Daniels will get back on track and be a problem for the rest of the NFC East. Kyler Murray has everything he needs in Minnesota to succeed if he can maximize Kevin O'Connell's offense.

The NFC East could provide a demanding test, with every divisional opponent possessing enough talent to punish inconsistency. Daniels' ability to protect the football, make quicker decisions and sustain drives will be critical if Washington hopes to turn the surrounding optimism into meaningful wins.

Fowler's projection ultimately reflects the belief that Daniels' best football may still be ahead of him. If he recaptures his rookie-year impact , the quarterback could move from a player seeking a reset to one of the NFC East's most disruptive and influential stars.

articles.title: This is what women in sport look like - Hunt
articles.summary: British sprinter Amy Hunt is among the female athletes to criticise the controversial betting advert starring actress Sydney Sweeney.
articles.body:
British sprinter Amy Hunt is among the female athletes to speak out against a controversial sports gambling advert starring actress Sydney Sweeney.

The advert has gone viral online and features American Sweeney naked but covering parts of her body with various pieces of sporting equipment.

It has sparked a strong reaction, with many female athletes criticising its sexualisation of women in sport, and how they are being defined by their appearance rather than their achievements as sportswomen.

Hunt, who became a four-time European champion earlier this summer, referenced the advert after she ran a season's best 22.10 seconds to finish fourth in the 200m final at the Ultimate Championship in Budapest on Sunday.

"Sydney Sweeney, this is what women in sport look like," Hunt said in her post-race interview with BBC Sport.

Referring to Melissa Jefferson-Wooden's winning time of 21.47 seconds, the fourth fastest ever over the distance, she added: "21.4. Muscles. Hard work, blood, sweat, tears. This is a beautiful evening."

American actress Sweeney, 29, starred in the television series Euphoria and her films include Anyone But You and The Housemaid.

The backlash has included many other athletes from a range of sports posting videos of themselves competing or training, and describing the frustrations and struggles they have faced throughout their careers.

The trend was started by American gymnast Gracie Kramer, who posted a montage of herself training with the caption, "I don't know what Sydney Sweeney was doing, but this is what women in sport look like."

Australia's four-time Olympic swimming champion Ariarne Titmus said: "Not only is it a kick in the face to every woman who has dedicated her life to perfecting her craft, but every woman who enjoys sports for what it really is.

"How do we live in a world where monetising a woman's body and sexualising women's sport is still a thing?"

British cyclist and Olympic champion Sophie Capewell MBE, rugby players Lisa Neumann and Ellie Boatman and Australian water polo Olympian Tilly Kearns also shared their stories.

Sweeney has not commented in response but she took to social media to post a range of photos of other athletes posing naked or in limited clothing, appearing to suggest hypocrisy.

The photos were a series of ESPN covers featuring the likes of tennis star Serena Williams and MMA fighter and wrestler Ronda Rousey, alongside male athletes including NFL player Myles Garrett and basketball player Karl-Anthony Towns.

articles.title: Diogo Dalot reacts to landmark Man United achievement
articles.summary: 2 Manchester United defender Diogo Dalot delivered a rousing message after reaching a significant club milestone.Landmark featDalot made his 250th United app...
articles.body:
Manchester United defender Diogo Dalot delivered a rousing message after reaching a significant club milestone.

Dalot made his 250th United appearance during Sunday's 1-0 defeat to Manchester City at Old Trafford.

He was named in the starting XI by Michael Carrick. He endured a difficult game as Erling Haaland 's controversial 60th-minute strike denied United a share of the spoils.

The Portugal international struggled against Antoine Semenyo , making multiple defensive lapses that nearly proved costly for the Red Devils.

A sublime Bruno Fernandes cross put it on a plate for him, but he couldn't quite connect properly to force Gianluigi Donnarumma into action.

Dalot's 250th appearance for United may have fizzled out into a whimper, but the milestone itself is nothing to scoff at. He has come a long way since Jose Mourinho greenlit his move from Porto in 2018.

The 27-year-old has been deployed all over the pitch and even had a loan spell at AC Milan along the way.

Dalot said , "It is a huge honour to continue writing history with this club. I arrived here very young, hoping to stay long enough to experience moments and achievements like these."

"Reaching 250 appearances for Manchester United, in a game as special as the Manchester derby, makes this milestone even more meaningful."

He added, "This club is built to compete at the highest level, in the biggest matches and for the most important trophies, and I am proud to have helped Manchester United along this journey."

"But the work is far from finished, and this landmark is another step in the journey to the ultimate goal: winning titles wearing the Manchester United shirt."

Dalot and his United teammates will be eager to make amends on Wednesday when they face Brighton & Hove Albion in the third round of the FA Cup.

articles.title: Lele Adani says this Juventus is not even close to being a great team
articles.summary: Lele Adani says the current Juventus team is nowhere near being a great side after their latest defeat at the hands of Sassuolo, with injuries and poor form...
articles.body:
Lele Adani says the current Juventus team is nowhere near being a great side after their latest defeat at the hands of Sassuolo , with injuries and poor form threatening to derail another season for the men in black and white.

Juve have been one of the top teams punching below their weight for some time, and fans had believed this would be a better campaign under Luciano Spalletti. The club had hoped his experience could help them compete more strongly.

When Spalletti first arrived as their manager last term, the team showed encouraging signs of improvement, which is why Juventus decided to give him a contract to remain in charge for another season.

Spalletti is an experienced manager who won Serie A in 2023, and he certainly has the credentials to win the league title with the current Juventus team. However, they have not made the start to this season that the club and supporters would have wanted.

The manager and his players will continue doing their best to improve their form and will look to respond in their next fixture. However, the latest defeat has once again raised questions about the quality of the squad and whether Juventus have enough to challenge at the highest level.

Juve need to find consistency if they are to turn their season around. Injuries have made that task more difficult , while individual mistakes have also contributed to their problems. For Adani, those issues demonstrate that the team still has a considerable distance to cover.

(Photo by Emmanuele Ciancaglini/Getty Images)

Adani believes Juventus are far from being a great side, pointing to mistakes from several players as evidence of the problems facing the team. He also questioned whether the manager is putting his players in the best position to perform.

"Juventus is unable to put the players in a position to perform. And I wonder: is it a great team? She's far from being one in my opinion. If Conceiçao is aiming and always misses something, if Kelly misreads situations and if Kolo Muani makes a mistake in tying up the game, these are harmful episodes and when you make a mistake you lose the games."

The comments underline the pressure now facing Spalletti and his players. Juventus must find a way to reduce their mistakes and improve their performances if they are to make this season a successful one.

The Giants also possess a defensive front that Fowler considers well-stocked, even after the departure of Dexter Lawrence II.
